Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 15.7 x 23.6 inch. Quantity: 1 piece.

Distinctive gold finish adds a defined, decorative appearance to Christmas displays.

7906816233133.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Set of 2 Pine Trees: Bring warm, rustic charm to your home with this set of 2 artificial Christmas trees. Each tree features a pine silhouette with 131 branch tips, blended PVC foliage and detailed pine needles, finished with a decorative wooden-barrel style pot base for a rich,coordinated festive display.
Dual-colour remote lighting: Each tree features 100 pre-lit LEDs with warm white and multicolour options, offering 11 lighting functions. Use the included 5m remote control to easily switch between settings, from steady glow to breathing and wave modes,and customise your holiday ambience.
Pre-decorated: Add natural forest charm to your seasonal decor. Each tree comes pre-decorated with 18 realistic-looking pine cones and 18 vibrant red berry clusters nestled among the dense foliage, creating a richly detailed holiday display without extra decorations.
Battery powered for flexible placement: Powered by a battery box, these illuminated Christmas trees can be placed anywhere without a wall outlet. Convenient build and storage: Each 4ft Christmas tree features a two-section trunk structure secured in a plastic pot base, with branches that are easy to expand by hand. 5037204484133.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Clear. Stated size: 8 cm. Quantity: 20 pack.
Pack of 20 clear plastic baubles for festive tree decoration.
Lightweight design makes them easy to handle and hang on branches.
8 cm size provides a defined focal point for seasonal arrangements.
Clear finish adds colour and detail without overpowering the display.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 20x Christmas baubles
Hanger included

5096042286033.variantName: Christmas Ornaments - Tree Decorations - Flocked Pleated Finish - Burgundy Plastic - For Seasonal Home Displays - 28 Ornaments
5096042286033.sourceDescription:
Twenty-eight burgundy ornaments combine plastic cores with plush fabric and pleated details. Balls, stars, candy canes, presents and leaf shapes form a varied hanging collection with metal caps. The coordinated contents let you plan the main colours and shapes before placing the individual decorations, so the arrangement can follow the space available.

The ornaments have a plastic core covered with plush fabric and pleated details. This combination creates a flocked surface and a shaped outline, adding texture as well as colour to the tree. Space the textured pieces between smoother decorations to make the different finishes visible, or group them together for a display centred on soft surfaces.

Metal caps finish the tops of the ornaments and provide the point used for hanging. Arrange each piece from its top attachment so that the decorative shape hangs below the branch. Varying the position across the tree lets you fill open spaces and keeps the ornaments from sitting directly against one another when the branches are close together.

The mix of shapes creates variation while keeping the colour scheme coordinated. Round pieces can fill open gaps, while the other outlines bring a change of shape among the branches. Spread similar designs around the tree for a repeating pattern, or group a few together to make a smaller themed section within a larger Christmas display.

Designed as hanging decorations, the pieces can be distributed across the branches or brought together in a smaller seasonal arrangement. Start with the areas that face into the room, then turn the individual ornaments until their shapes can be seen.

When taking down the display, remove each decoration from its support before packing it away. Keep the pieces together and avoid placing heavy objects against their decorative faces. This keeps the collection organised for the next time you arrange a Christmas tree or seasonal display.
Includes 28 assorted burgundy ornaments in balls, stars, candy canes, presents and leaf shapes for a coordinated seasonal display.
Features a textured flocked pleated finish with plush fabric covering plastic cores for added visual depth and tactile interest.
Each piece is finished with a metal cap at the top to provide a secure attachment point for hanging on tree branches.
The varied mix of traditional Christmas shapes allows you to create repeating patterns or grouped themed sections on your tree.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

8941467526233.variantName: Velvet Christmas Baubles Ornaments for Tree 15 Pack Shatterproof Xmas Decorations Red Green Brown Beige 80mm 3.15 in
8941467526233.sourceDescription:
This 15-piece set of velvet Christmas baubles comes in four classic shades: red, green, brown and beige. The palette is warm and tonal, giving a traditional, minimalist look that helps a tree feel harmonious rather than busy, and the deep reds and greens sit neatly alongside the softer brown and beige pieces. The 15 baubles can be grouped by shade for a graduated effect or mixed together for a fuller, layered look.

Each bauble is handmade, with velvet fabric wrapped around a round plastic ball and finished with a silk ribbon plus pleats in the top fleece for a distinctive, tailored shape. The velvet surface gives a warm, luxurious finish that suits both traditional and modern schemes. Because the baubles are shatterproof rather than glass, they stay sturdy through the season and can be packed away and reused year after year.

At 80 mm (3.15 in) across, they are large enough to act as focal points and centrepieces on the tree without weighing down the branches. They are light, simple to hang and a safer choice for homes with small children or pets, and the generous size means a single bauble reads clearly from across a room.

Hang them on the Christmas tree, or use them to dress a wreath, garland or mantelpiece. They also suit weddings, engagements, anniversaries and parties, and make a thoughtful gift for anyone building a coordinated festive display.

Christmas Tree Skirt

This product is designed to dress the area around the base of a Christmas tree. It is intended for christmas display, with the dimensions, construction and operating features set out below.

Product details
Stated measurement: 150 cm. Pack quantity: 2 pieces.

The textile adds a distinct layer to the chosen setting, with the stated size and colour helping it sit alongside existing furnishings. Compare the measurements with the item or area it will cover before planning the finished arrangement.

Material and construction influence the feel, drape and care of a textile. The stated fabric details provide a basis for choosing a suitable cleaning method, while the overall dimensions help establish how much of the underlying surface will remain visible.

The design can be coordinated with surrounding colours and textures to create a considered arrangement. Allow for the shape of the supporting item and any movement needed during everyday use rather than selecting only by a nominal size.

Position the textile according to its intended role and keep any relevant fastenings or openings accessible. Where it covers another item, check that the fit does not prevent normal adjustment, access or removal.

Follow the product care instructions for washing, drying and storage. A material name alone does not establish a machine-wash setting, drying temperature or specialist performance, so use the stated method for this construction.

For seasonal storage, clean and dry the item first where appropriate, then fold or arrange it without unnecessary pressure on decorative details. Keep it in a suitable dry place until it is needed again.

For selection, compare the christmas tree skirt with the intended arrangement using the stated measurements and product details.

Keep the relevant parts together between uses so that the christmas tree skirt can be identified and arranged for the next task.
Comes as a set of two festive tree skirts to provide ample coverage for your Christmas display.
Generous 150 cm diameter size ensures the base of your Christmas tree is fully dressed and concealed.
Soft textile construction adds a decorative layer that complements existing seasonal furnishings.
Designed specifically for Christmas displays, offering a practical and festive solution for tree bases.

The base is a soft velvet with a dense sequin pattern stitched on, and the edges are finished so nothing catches on the carpet. An invisible hook-and-loop strip at the opening means you can fit it round the tree and press it closed. At 90 cm it suits larger trees, roughly 6 ft and up, and it can also be used indoors or in a sheltered porch. Hand wash or cold machine wash, then dry flat.

Red velvet and gold sequins is a combination that has worked for a very long time.

Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its black finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Compact design fits easily into smaller spaces without overwhelming your display.
Versatile black finish coordinates effortlessly with various festive colour schemes.
Single item allows for flexible placement as a standalone focal point or part of a group.

5052532160733.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Product measurements: length 6 cm, width 7.6 cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Pack of 12 festive Father Christmas motifs for versatile holiday decorating.
Compact dimensions of 6 cm length and 7.6 cm width for flexible placement.
Durable plastic construction designed to maintain its shape and detail.
Classic Santa design adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering

8956086258533.variantName: Christmas Snowman Tea Towels Set of 4 18 x 26 in Red and Black Soft Absorbent Machine Washable Kitchen Decor
8956086258533.sourceDescription:
Bring a touch of festive charm to your kitchen with this set of four snowman print tea towels. Each towel is made from 100% durable polyester fibre that feels soft in the hand, so you can dry glasses, plates, pots and pans without scratching delicate surfaces or leaving lint behind. The fabric is machine washable and can be tumble dried, which keeps everyday cleaning simple and helps the towels stay smart wash after wash.

Absorbency is the heart of a good tea towel, and these are made to take up water quickly. They cope with drying, wiping down worktops, mopping up spills and any other household job, and they hold on to that absorbency even after repeated machine cycles. The generous size gives you plenty of cloth to work with, whether you are drying a full dish rack or covering a bowl of dough while it proves.

Each towel measures 18 x 26 inches (43 cm x 66 cm) and the set contains four tea towels in a red and black colourway. The snowman pattern is printed in a stylish, playful design that sits happily alongside Christmas decorations, yet it is calm enough to stay out all winter. Hang them on the oven rail, use them as a soft layer under festive table settings, or give the set as a small Christmas gift for someone who loves seasonal homeware.
Guarantee - 1 month

5056797097933.sourceDescription:
Give your front door a sleek, modern festive look with this LED ring wreath from MySmartBuy. A clean metal ring is lit with warm white LEDs, creating a minimalist wreath of light that suits contemporary homes beautifully. It is available in 36cm, 44cm and 55cm sizes, with up to 96 LEDs, and offers 8 lighting modes to suit your display. Hang it on doors, walls, gates and porches for a stylish outdoor display. It is supplied with a 3m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: metal ring wreath | warm white LEDs | 36cm, 44cm or 55cm | up to 96 LEDs | 8 lighting modes | 3m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | outdoor use.
MODERN LED RING : A sleek metal ring wreath lit with warm white LEDs for a minimalist festive look.
THREE SIZES : Available in 36cm, 44cm and 55cm, with up to 96 LEDs.
8 LIGHTING MODES : Choose the effect that suits your display.
3M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 3m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Ideal for front doors, walls, gates and porches.

5056797098633.sourceDescription:
Create a rich, sparkling glow with these warm white cluster lights from MySmartBuy. Densely packed seed LEDs on a discreet green wire give a fuller, more luxurious effect than standard string lights. Choose from 8 lighting modes, and wrap them around trees, wreaths, garlands, hedges and fences. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The built-in timer lights them for 8 hours and then switches them off for 16 hours, so they come on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Festive lights are among the most versatile decorations you can own. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. At a glance: warm white cluster lights | seed LEDs | green wire | 8 lighting modes | 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.
WARM WHITE CLUSTER LIGHTS : Densely packed seed LEDs on a discreet green wire.
FULL, SPARKLING EFFECT : A richer, more luxurious glow than standard string lights.
8 LIGHTING MODES : Choose the effect to suit the mood.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Ideal for trees, wreaths, garlands, hedges and fences.

5037204452033.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its black finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

No Drill Fitting
The fitting method does not require drilling for the stated application, making it useful when you want to add an accessory without making new fixing holes.

Adjustable Design
Adjustment allows the item to be set for the intended arrangement. Choose the position or fit that matches the available space and check it before use.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Colour: Black. Quantity: 4 piece set.
Set of four black Christmas wreaths for festive door decoration
No drill fitting allows easy installation without damaging surfaces
Adjustable design enables custom positioning to suit any space
Reusable construction ensures long-lasting seasonal enjoyment
Comes with Set of 4 Christmas wreaths

8776446731533.sourceDescription:
This Christmas wreath features a unique wagon-wheel design, bringing a cozy, farmhouse-style charm to the holiday season. Unlike traditional round wreaths, this rustic hanging decoration is perfect for front doors, porches, entryways, walls, or any indoor
 space in need of a festive touch.
Combining a wooden wagon-wheel motif with classic Christmas accents, this piece blends seamlessly into farmhouse, rustic, vintage, or country-style home decor. It helps create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout the holiday season, welcoming family
 and guests alike.
Versatile placement options:
Front and back doors
Porches and entryways
Living room walls or windows
Fireplace areas and festive display corners
Christmas parties and family gatherings
Effortless holiday decorating
The hanging design makes it easy to display and reposition. Please check the product dimensions before ordering to ensure it fits your intended door or wall space. If placing it outdoors, we recommend choosing a sheltered area to protect it from direct
 rain and harsh weather.
A thoughtful Christmas gift
If you are looking for a holiday gift for someone who loves rustic home decor, this wooden wagon-wheel Christmas wreath is an excellent choice for friends, family, neighbors, or hosts of holiday gatherings.

Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5059442204533.sourceDescription:
Bring a living tree into your home for Christmas and enjoy the character that comes with choosing a pot-grown Blue Spruce. Its dense blue-green foliage and naturally conical shape create a full, well-balanced tree, while the slightly more rigid needles help the branches hold their shape beneath heavy lights and decorations. The unusual colouring sets it apart from other varieties, giving this real Christmas tree a distinctive appearance without needing to overdo the decorations.
DISTINCTIVE BLUE SPRUCE: Blue-green foliage and dense branching give this tree its characteristic appearance, with a naturally conical shape that looks full and well balanced. It also makes an attractive outdoor Christmas tree once the festive season has finished.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
NEEDLES THAT HOLD WELL: Blue Spruce is known for its good needle retention, helping it maintain a full, fresh appearance throughout the Christmas period. This makes it a practical option for enjoying a real tree indoors without the rapid needle drop associated with some varieties.
YEAR-ROUND EVERGREEN TREES FOR GARDEN STRUCTURE: Blue Spruce keeps its blue-green foliage throughout the year, so its interest doesn't end when the Christmas decorations come down. Its evergreen character can add structure and colour to an outdoor space through every season.
CARE FOR YOUR LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Keep the compost moist while the tree is indoors, but avoid leaving it sitting in excess water. Position it away from radiators, fires, and other direct sources of heat, and keep its time indoors to the festive period rather than treating it like a permanent houseplant.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
